known_limits: No production deployment or native customer installation acceptance.
No current-HEAD real autonomous Decision -> recovery -> worker execution; paid changes remain unvalidated.
No semantic/artistic quality verifier; unknown is not success.
No rollback of committed project state, provider effects or spent credits. SQLite transaction rollback and config cancel are narrower.
No arbitrary code edits, arbitrary prompts, independent agent selection or unrestricted provider switch.
Video/audio/assembly/publication managed execution disabled. ffmpeg/ffprobe and ASR packages/weights unavailable in recorded test image; not rechecked by running app now.
Profiles accepted with synthetic alternate model only; production catalog disabled/empty by default.
Image reference upload/media model changes/provider real jobs not accepted.
Automatic Decision tick starts only for current exhausted invalid_json/missing_payload text incidents, not every error family.
Historical 204-pass/1-skip and other totals are not a single current-HEAD acceptance.
Latest current worker proof covers five text nodes + image, omits HTML; historical full six-text+image proof is separate.
Latest recovery restart proof reconstructs context/Observer, not a hard-killed whole worker process.
continuation_submitted means call submitted, not confirmed successor start; actual NodeRun/managed_successor needed.
Historical SQLite OperationalError root cause unproven; lost original message cannot be reconstructed.
Docker interruptions/OOM occurred historically; exited137 does not imply failed ledger or graceful whole-container exit.
Gateway pin may change; preflight must fail closed. Shared destination IP still needs independent TLS/URL checks.
Model request/token cap is not a money ceiling; no verified provider-side hard monetary cap.
Filesystem+SQLite not one atomic transaction; unindexed body and uncertain reservation possible on crash; unsaved tail cannot be promised.
Host node/python process ownership unproven by names; no foreign process stopped.
No TODO/FIXME/stub/NotImplemented markers found in the inspected new core service subset; this does not mean no unfinished functionality or no legacy placeholders.
